contexts.text: Shittim woods () = the goods of merit which are from the Lord, thus of the Lord alone. Explained.
Shittim wood was the wood of the most excellent cedar, (see Cedar); as is evident from I will place in the wilderness the cedar of Shittah (); where the cedar of Shittah = spiritual good.
Of Shittim woods () = righteousness; for Shittim wood = the good of merit which is of the Lord alone; thus also righteousness, which is the good of merit. Explained. AC 9715, Explained.
As by the ark is signified Heaven where the Lord is, Shittim wood was employed for its construction...
For within there was Shittim wood... and by Shittim wood is signified the good itself proceeding from His Divine Human.
Shittim woods = the good of merit which is of the Lord alone. AC 9528. AC 9662. AC 9674. AC 9689.
Of Shittim woods () = from mercy... For the good of merit is mercy.
Hence the boards were of Shittim wood, by which is signified the good which supports Heaven.
With Shittim woods () = the good of merit from His Divine Human... This good is the only good which reigns in Heaven, and supports it.

Staves with Shittim woods () = the good of righteousness, and the derivative power... Shittim woods = the good of merit, or the good of righteousness: this good is the good of love of His Divine Human.

With Shittim woods thou shalt make it () = from love Divine. Shittim wood = the good of merit and of righteousness which is of the Lord alone. The reason it also = love, is that when the Lord was in the world He fought from Divine love against all the Hells... and thus saved the human race, and hence alone has merit, and has become righteousness; and therefore the Lord's good of merit is His Divine love. That Shittim wood is of such and so great a signification. Explained.
Staves with Shittim woods () = power from the good of love of the Lord.

The wood called Shittim, which was a tree on mount Sinai, or at its base, signifies a most noble cedar. It is a mountain tree, excellent before other trees from its aromatic oil, thus from its odour, and purity.
The cedar of shittah = genuine truth. ( = rational truths. AE 730:24.)
That shittim wood = the good of righteousness or of merit of the Lord. References.
Shall water the stream of shittim () = shall illustrate those in cognitions and scientifics. AE 483:5. ( = the illustration of the understanding. AE 518:10.)
